mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 74 degrees near Verona City Hall, with a beautiful waxing crescent moon visible tonight.

The Verona Police Department released a recap of service calls from October 5 through October 12, noting several traffic accidents, including a motorcycle crash on USH 18/151 and an e-moto collision on Basswood Avenue.
There is plenty to do in Verona, with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga, and more trivia nights happening tomorrow.
On October 9, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash near mile marker 76 on USH 18/151 that resulted in one person being transported to the hospital.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake, and you can head over to enjoy it anytime before the store closes at 10 PM.
